claims.text: The network uses mean square error as the loss function for final classification, which outperformed binary cross entropy in this context.
RMSprop is employed for parameter optimization during training of the network.
The output of the network is evaluated using softmax to interpret classification results as probabilities.
The sense inventory for nouns and adjectives is based on WordNet 1.7.1, which is a metric for evaluating the sense disambiguation task.
